svg.title: Enterprise staff portal
svg.desc: Staff and leadership use a browser-based portal that calls an API Gateway HTTP API in eu-west-2. API Gateway invokes Lambda handlers, which read and write requests, sessions and notifications in DynamoDB and send status email through Amazon SES. EventBridge schedules trigger reminders and digests.

text.tspan: A serverless leave and payroll-advance approval system on API Gateway, Lambda and DynamoDB, with email updates and scheduled reminders.
Staff sign in and raise a leave or payroll-advance request in the portal.
API Gateway hands each call to a Lambda handler, which checks the user’s role.
Request state, sessions and the notification feed are stored in DynamoDB.
When leadership approves or declines, Amazon SES emails the requester.
EventBridge schedules run the reminders and digests. Nothing polls.
